name: view_duel_uncork_by_click_in_the_rivals_wave
description: A click on a corked bottle uncorks it while the duel's wave runs on either hollow (contract-m7.md §3), on Undertow's own rules against the caretaker, as Space does. A pack corked with key 1 in window 2; Space is Ready, and the one horn sounds wave 2 on both hollows. My hollow clears it first (its creeps walked to the Holdfast with the logged distance setter) and stands in window 3 while the rival's road still waits for my bottle (SimUndertow.holds). From 3 s after the horn my bottle's socket is lit with its Space key, and the socket answers a click: it is not greyed by my own hollow's phase, the click sends the UNCORK, and the simulation takes the reveal.

steps.assert: Game.my_bottles().size() == 1 and Game.my_bottles()[0]['known'] and Game.my_bottles()[0]['pack'] == first
Game.state == Game.State.PREP and Game.sim.hollows[1].phase == 1 and Game.duel_wave() and not Game.bottles_of(1)[0]['uncorked']
steps.msg: my hollow cleared wave 2 and stands in its window; the rival's still plays it, waiting for my bottle

steps.assert: mine.size() == 1 and mine[0]['lit'] and mine[0]['space'] and Game.uncork_refusal(mine[0]['id']) == ''
steps.msg: the socket is lit with its Space key: the bottle may be uncorked
and its socket answers a click, though my own hollow is in its window
the lit bottle still shows its pack's face, beside the Space key, not under it

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 7).size() == 1 and Game.bottles_of(1)[0]['uncorked'] and Game.bottles_of(1)[0]['pack'] == first and Game.my_bottles().is_empty()
steps.msg: the click sent the UNCORK, and the simulation took the reveal
its pack walks the rival's road
the UNCORK reveals the salt its CORK committed to
